_comment: Signature (prestige) ranks — earned on the site by fully completing whole rank categories (Savant 5/7, Curator 6/7, Paragon 7/7). The site writes players.signature_rank + players.prefer_signature_rank; the bot mirrors the CHOSEN rank (signature when the member opted in, otherwise their composite ladder rank in config/ranks.json). Ordered low → high for upgrade detection.
